categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Gaoce Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of high-hardness brittle material cutting equipment and consumables. Its main products include photovoltaic (PV) cutting equipment such as diamond wire saws, single crystal cutting machines, and cutting consumables like diamond wires. The company also provides silicon wafer cutting and processing services and extends its technology to semiconductor, sapphire, magnetic materials, and silicon carbide cutting sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including precision mechanical design and manufacturing, automation detection and control, and precision electrochemical technology. It has developed advanced diamond wire cutting technology with innovations in tungsten wire cold drawing, fine wire iteration, high-speed cutting, and intelligent control systems. Production methods emphasize integrated solutions combining cutting equipment, consumables, and cutting processes, supported by proprietary manufacturing lines for diamond wire and cutting machines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are photovoltaic silicon wafer manufacturers, semiconductor wafer producers, sapphire crystal manufacturers, magnetic material producers, and silicon carbide material processors. The company serves upstream segments of the PV industry chain, focusing on silicon wafer production, and extends services to semiconductor and other high-hardness brittle material industries. Major end markets include global PV manufacturers and emerging semiconductor and advanced material sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Qingdao, Yibin, Salt City, Leshan, Luoyang, and Changzhi. It has expanded its global footprint with overseas subsidiaries and sales in countries including Laos, India, the United States, France, Vietnam, Turkey, and parts of Europe and Southeast Asia. The company actively participates in international exhibitions and is expanding its global sales and service network.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingdao Gaoce Technology operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the photovoltaic and semiconductor supply chains. It supplies critical cutting equipment and consumables used in silicon wafer manufacturing and provides wafer cutting processing services, positioning itself as a key technology and equipment provider within the manufacturing process of high-hardness brittle materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous innovation in fine wire diamond cutting technology, automation, and intelligent manufacturing. R&D priorities include advancing tungsten wire cold drawing, ultra-fine wire cutting, high-speed and high-precision cutting equipment, and integrated solutions for cutting, grinding, and chamfering in semiconductor and advanced materials. It also invests in AI-driven smart factory solutions and expands R&D centers across multiple locations to support diversified applications and global competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of cutting equipment and consumables, silicon wafer cutting and processing services, and innovative business segments including precision grinding equipment. The company uses a direct sales model with some consignment sales for consumables and contracts for processing services. Revenue streams include product sales, processing service fees, and government subsidies related to technology development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier in China for high-hardness brittle material cutting equipment and consumables, holding the top market share in photovoltaic cutting equipment and a significant position in diamond wire products globally. It competes with other specialized equipment manufacturers in the PV and semiconductor sectors, leveraging its integrated technology and service solutions to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 4.47 billion, a 27.65% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to industry-wide price declines. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 44.2 million, reflecting a challenging market environment and increased impairment provisions. The company has total assets of about RMB 7.75 billion and net assets of RMB 3.68 billion, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D despite short-term profitability pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingdao Gaoce Technology emphasizes its integrated 'equipment + consumables + process' technology closed-loop, delivering comprehensive cutting solutions that reduce production costs, improve efficiency, and enhance product quality for high-hardness brittle materials. Its proprietary fine wire diamond cutting technology, especially in tungsten wire cold drawing and ultra-fine wire iteration, provides superior cutting precision and cost advantages. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and global service network further differentiate it as a technology leader and reliable partner in the PV and semiconductor industries.
